notablePrerequisites:
Opponents control at least two artifacts and/or enchantments.
Fractured Realm is unlocked.
description:
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating at least four Treasure tokens.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}{U}{R}.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Bottomless Pool.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Bottomless Pool.
Bottomless Pool triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, returning Dockside Extortionist from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the second trigger, choosing not to return anything to your hand.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Marina.
Repeat.
